title: WrestleMania VIII
summary: This document is an article about WrestleMania VIII, the eighth annual WrestleMania professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF, now WWE), held on April 5, 1992, at the Hoosier Dome in Indianapolis, Indiana. The article begins with an overview of the event, highlighting featured matches including Roddy Piper defending the WWF Intercontinental Championship against Bret Hart, Ric Flair defending the WWF Championship against Randy Savage, and Hulk Hogan facing Sid Justice. The "Production" section covers the background of WrestleMania as the WWF's flagship annual event and one of the original "Big Four" pay-per-views, along with the storylines leading into the event, including the originally planned main event between Ric Flair and Hulk Hogan that was changed to a double main event format. The "Event" section provides a match-by-match account of all bouts, including a dark match between the Beverly Brothers and the Bushwhackers, title matches, and the main event between Hulk Hogan and Sid Justice, which ended by disqualification with a botched finish involving Papa Shango and a surprise return by Ultimate Warrior. The "Reception" section summarizes critical reviews, with praise for the Piper-Hart and Flair-Savage matches but harsh criticism of the Hogan-Justice main event, which was ranked as the worst WrestleMania main event of all time by Cultaholic. The "Aftermath" section describes post-event storylines, including the continued Savage-Flair feud over Elizabeth, Shawn Michaels' rise as a singles competitor, and the departures or hiatuses of several wrestlers such as Hulk Hogan, Roddy Piper, Jake Roberts, and Sid Justice. The document concludes with sections for results, references, and external links.
